Fortis.title: Fortis Hospital
Fortis.intro: <bold>Fortis Healthcare Limited </bold>(fortis hospital) is a prominent private healthcare provider in India, headquartered in Gurgaon. Established in 1996, it operates a network of 36 hospitals across 11 states, including facilities in Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Mumbai, and Punjab. The company is known for its multidisciplinary approach, offering comprehensive medical services through hospitals, diagnostics, and day care specialty centers. (Fortis Healthcare)

Fortis.cardiology: <bold>Cardiology & Cardiac Surgery</bold> – Advanced heart treatments including coronary artery bypass, valve surgeries, angioplasty.
Fortis.oncology: <bold>Oncology</bold> – Comprehensive cancer care from diagnosis to treatment.
Fortis.orthopedics: <bold>Orthopedics </bold>– Musculoskeletal disorders, joint replacement, fracture care.
Fortis.urology: <bold>Urology</bold> – Kidney, urinary tract, and male reproductive system treatments.
Fortis.gastroenterology: <bold>Gastroenterology</bold> – Digestive system disorders and liver care.
Fortis.pediatrics: <bold>Pediatrics </bold>– Medical care for infants and children.

Medanta.medantaIntroductionContent1: <bold>Medanta – The Medicity</bold> is one of India’s leading multi-super-specialty hospital networks, founded in<bold> 2009</bold>  by world-renowned cardiac surgeon <bold>Dr. Naresh Trehan.</bold>  Located in <bold>Gurugram, Haryana,</bold>  with branches in<bold> Lucknow, Indore, Ranchi, Patna<bold>, and other cities, Medanta is known for delivering world-class patient care, advanced medical technology, and some of the most skilled doctors in India.
Medanta.medantaIntroductionContent2: Its mission is to provide <bold>integrated, ethical, and affordable healthcare</bold> , combining modern technology with compassionate care.
Medanta.departmentsContent: Medanta covers more than 30 super-specialties. Here are the key ones:
Medanta.cardiology: <bold>Cardiology & Cardiac Surgery – </bold> Advanced cardiac care, bypass surgeries, valve replacements, aortic surgeries.
Medanta.oncology: <bold>Oncology –</bold>  Comprehensive cancer care with chemotherapy, radiation, targeted therapy, immunotherapy, and robotic oncology surgery.
Medanta.neurosciences: <bold>Neurosciences – </bold> Neurosurgery, neuro-intervention, spine surgery, and stroke management.
Medanta.orthopedics: <bold>Orthopedics & Joint Replacement –</bold>  Knee, hip, and shoulder replacement, complex trauma, sports injury management.
Medanta.urology: <bold>Urology & Nephrology –</bold>  Kidney stone treatment, prostate surgeries, dialysis, and kidney transplantation.
Medanta.gastroenterology: <bold>Gastroenterology & Hepatology – </bold> Liver disease management, endoscopy, ERCP, and liver transplants.
Medanta.pulmonology: <bold>Pulmonology & Thoracic Surgery –</bold>  Lung disease management, thoracic surgeries, and lung transplantation.
Medanta.endocrinology: <bold>Endocrinology & Diabetes Care – </bold> Thyroid, adrenal, pituitary disorder management, and diabetes programs.
Medanta.pediatrics: <bold>Pediatrics & Neonatology – </bold> Pediatric ICU, neonatal ICU, pediatric surgeries, congenital defect treatment.
Medanta.obgyn: <bold>Obstetrics & Gynecology – </bold> Maternity, fetal medicine, IVF, minimally invasive gynecologic surgery.
Medanta.criticalCare: <bold>Critical Care & Emergency – </bold> 24×7 trauma and emergency care with rapid response teams.
Medanta.dermatology: <bold>Dermatology & Cosmetology –</bold>  Skin treatments, laser procedures, and cosmetic dermatology.
Medanta.plasticSurgery: <bold>Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery –</bold>  Cosmetic surgeries, trauma reconstruction, burns care.
Medanta.bariatricSurgery: <bold>Bariatric & Metabolic Surgery – </bold> Weight-loss surgery for obesity and metabolic syndrome.
Medanta.keySpecialization2: <bold>Bone Marrow & Organ Transplants (Liver, Kidney, Heart, Lungs)</bold>
Medanta.treatment1: <bold>Treatments: </bold> Chemotherapy, Radiation Therapy, Immunotherapy, Cardiac Rehabilitation, Diabetes & Endocrine Care.
Medanta.treatment2: <bold>Surgeries: </bold> Robotic Heart Surgery, Spine Surgery, Thoracic Surgery, GI Surgery, Bariatric Surgery.
Medanta.treatment3: <bold>Implants: </bold> Joint Replacements, Dental Implants, Cochlear Implants, Cardiac Stents & Pacemakers.
Medanta.treatment4: <bold>Transplants:</bold>  Liver, Kidney, Heart, Lung, Bone Marrow.

Apollo.introParagraph1: Apollo Hospitals is one of <bold>Asia’s largest and most trusted healthcare groups<bold/>, founded in 1983 by <bold>Dr. Prathap C. Reddy.<bold/> Headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, Apollo has grown into a vast network of over <bold>70 hospitals, 4,000+ pharmacies, 150+ primary care clinics, and 110+ telemedicine centers <bold/>across India and abroad.
Apollo.introParagraph2: Apollo pioneered<bold> private healthcare in India<bold/>, introducing advanced medical technologies, international standards of patient care, and affordable treatment. The group is especially known for its work in <bold>cardiac sciences, organ transplantation, oncology, neurology, and robotic surgery.<bold/>
Apollo.introParagraph3: Its mission is to make<bold> world-class healthcare accessible and affordable<bold/>, blending innovation, compassion, and clinical excellence.

Artemis.artemisIntroParagraph1: Artemis Hospitals is a state-of-the-art, multi-specialty hospital located in Gurugram, Haryana, India. Spanning over 9 acres, the hospital boasts a capacity of over 750 beds and is recognized as the first JCI and NABH-accredited hospital in the region. Artemis is renowned for its commitment to providing world-class medical care, advanced technology, and patient-centered services.

ManipalHospital.manipalIntroParagraph: Manipal Hospitals is one of India’s leading private healthcare chains, renowned for delivering high-quality, patient-centric care across multiple specialties. Established with a vision to provide accessible, world-class medical services, Manipal Hospitals has a presence in multiple cities across India and overseas. With modern infrastructure, advanced medical technologies, and a large pool of experienced specialists, it offers comprehensive care for complex medical conditions.
ManipalHospital.departmentsParagraph: Manipal Hospitals offers a wide range of departments catering to diverse medical needs:
ManipalHospital.cardiology: <bold>Cardiology & Cardiac Surgery:</bold> Comprehensive care for heart diseases, including bypass surgery, angioplasty, valve repair, and cardiac rehabilitation.
ManipalHospital.neurology: <bold>Neurology & Neurosurgery:</bold> Management of neurological disorders, brain and spinal surgeries, stroke care, and neurocritical care.
ManipalHospital.oncology: <bold>Oncology:</bold> Multidisciplinary cancer care integrating medical, surgical, and radiation oncology, including advanced therapies like immunotherapy and robotic surgeries.
ManipalHospital.gastroenterology: <bold>Gastroenterology & Hepatology:</bold> Diagnosis and treatment of digestive system and liver diseases, including endoscopic interventions.
ManipalHospital.orthopaedics: <bold>Orthopaedics & Joint Replacement:</bold> Advanced care for bone and joint disorders, trauma, sports injuries, and minimally invasive joint replacement surgeries.
ManipalHospital.urology: <bold>Urology & Nephrology:</bold> Treatment for kidney and urinary tract disorders, dialysis, and kidney transplant services.
ManipalHospital.pulmonology: <bold>Pulmonology & Critical Care:</bold> Management of respiratory conditions, including interventional pulmonology and ICU care.
ManipalHospital.endocrinology: <bold>Endocrinology & Diabetes Care:</bold> Hormonal disorder management, including diabetes, thyroid, and metabolic disorders.
ManipalHospital.obgyn: <bold>Obstetrics & Gynaecology:</bold> Comprehensive care for women, including maternity services, high-risk pregnancies, and gynecologic surgeries.
ManipalHospital.pediatrics: <bold>Pediatrics & Neonatology:</bold> Specialized care for infants, children, and neonatal intensive care.
ManipalHospital.plasticSurgery: <bold>Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery:</bold> Cosmetic and reconstructive procedures, burn care, and post-trauma reconstruction.
ManipalHospital.emergencyCare: <bold>Emergency & Trauma Care:</bold> 24/7 trauma services, emergency medicine, and disaster management.

ManipalHospital.organTransplants: <bold>Organ Transplants:</bold> Liver, kidney, and bone marrow transplants with dedicated transplant units.
ManipalHospital.cardiacCare: <bold>Cardiac Care:</bold> Advanced treatments including minimally invasive cardiac surgeries and electrophysiology interventions.
ManipalHospital.neurosciences: <bold>Neurosciences:</bold> Brain and spinal surgeries, stroke care, epilepsy management, and neurorehabilitation.

max_hospitals.max_intro_paragraph: Max Healthcare is a premier private healthcare group in India, headquartered in New Delhi. It operates a network of super-speciality and multi-speciality hospitals with modern infrastructure, a large number of beds, and a wide pool of specialist doctors. Its mission is to deliver high quality, accessible, and patient-centric healthcare across specialties, using advanced medical technologies and globally benchmarked care standards.
max_hospitals.max_delhi_heading: Max Hospitals in Delhi NCR & Their Key Specialized Facilities
max_hospitals.max_delhi_intro: Here are some of the prominent Max Healthcare hospitals in Delhi NCR, with their known specializations and strengths:
max_hospitals.max_noida_facility: Max Super Speciality Hospital, Sector-128, Noida (Former Jaypee Hospital)
max_hospitals.max_noida_infra: ~500 beds (expanding to ~1,200 beds campus); large multidisciplinary team.
max_hospitals.max_noida_specialties: Organ transplants (liver & kidney), oncology (haematology and bone marrow transplant), orthopaedics & spine, neurosciences, critical care, cardiology, IVF & infertility.
max_hospitals.max_blk_facility: Max BLK-Max Super Speciality Hospital, Delhi
max_hospitals.max_blk_infra: Major flagship centre; large number of specialist clinics; known for high-end complex care.
max_hospitals.max_blk_specialties: Liver Transplant & Biliary Sciences, Cardiac Sciences (including electrophysiology / pacemakers), Oncology including robotic surgery, Gastroenterology & Hepatology.
max_hospitals.max_smart_facility: Max Smart Super Speciality Hospital, Saket
max_hospitals.max_smart_infra: ~250 beds; 50+ ICU beds; 12 modular operation theatres.
max_hospitals.max_smart_specialties: Orthopaedics & Joint Replacement, Cardiac Sciences, Oncology (medical, surgical, radiation), Neurosciences & Neurology, Transplants (liver, kidney, heart) & minimally invasive / robotic surgeries.
max_hospitals.max_vaishali_infra: ~350 beds; many specialties; large diagnostic setup; accredited by NABH & NABL.
max_hospitals.max_vaishali_specialties: Oncology, Neuro Sciences, Cardiac Sciences, Orthopaedics & Joint Replacement, Nephrology & Kidney Transplant, Liver Transplant, Urology, Gastroenterology, Bariatric Surgery.
max_hospitals.max_dwarka_infra: ~300+ beds; equipped with many critical care & specialty services.
max_hospitals.max_dwarka_specialties: Cardiac Sciences, Endoscopic & Bariatric Surgery, Renal Sciences, Neurosciences, Gastrointestinal & Liver Sciences, Cancer Care, Pulmonology, Pediatrics, ENT, Obstetrics & Gynecology, etc.
max_hospitals.max_shalimar_facility: Max Super Speciality Hospital, Shalimar Bagh
max_hospitals.max_shalimar_infra: Specialty centre with trauma & emergency, ICU units, and transplant capability.
max_hospitals.max_shalimar_specialties: Cardiac Sciences, Neurosciences, Oncology, Kidney Transplant, Gastro-Hepatology, Urology, Pulmonology & Emergency/Trauma.
max_hospitals.max_multicentre_infra: Out-patient centre + daycare facility with specialized OPDs, diagnostics, day surgeries, and preventive health check programs.
max_hospitals.max_multicentre_specialties: Preventive health check-ups, Daycare Surgeries, Diagnostics & Imaging, Specialty OPDs (Cardiology, Oncology, Orthopaedics, Endocrinology, ENT, Gastroenterology, Dermatology, etc.).
max_hospitals.max_departments_intro: Max Hospitals have a broad and deep range of departments, ensuring full coverage:
max_hospitals.max_dept2: Oncology (Medical, Surgical, Radiation, including Robotic Oncology)
max_hospitals.max_specializations_intro: Some areas where Max Hospitals are especially strong:
max_hospitals.max_spec3: Oncology, including robotic and minimally invasive oncology, CAR T-cell therapy features in some locations.
max_hospitals.max_spec4: Cardiac Sciences, including electrophysiology, pacemakers, complex surgeries
max_hospitals.max_tech_intro: Max Hospitals employ many advanced technologies that elevate their treatment quality:
max_hospitals.max_tech1: Da Vinci Xi Robotic Assisted Surgery systems (e.g., in Noida)
max_hospitals.max_tech2: TrueBeam STx Linear Accelerator for precise radiation therapy
max_hospitals.max_tech3: 3.0 Tesla MRI, 256-slice CT, PET-CT, etc. to provide high resolution imaging.
max_hospitals.max_tech4: Cath Labs, electrophysiology navigation for cardiac procedures
max_hospitals.max_tech5: Flat panel C-Arm detectors, advanced endoscopy & dialysis units (especially in Smart Saket)
max_hospitals.max_tech6: Modular operation theatres, high dependency & ICU / critical care infrastructure.
max_hospitals.max_treatments_intro: Max Hospitals offer a wide range of cutting-edge treatments, including:
max_hospitals.max_treatment1: Cancer treatment (chemotherapy, radiotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, surgical oncology)
max_hospitals.max_treatment2: Bariatric / Metabolic treatments for obesity, related metabolic disorders
max_hospitals.max_treatment3: Organ transplant treatments (pre- and post-op care)
max_hospitals.max_treatment4: Cardiac treatments: bypass, valve repair/replacement, angioplasty, device implants
max_hospitals.max_treatment5: Neurology / Neurosurgery treatments: stroke, spinal disorders, epilepsy etc.
max_hospitals.max_treatment6: Orthopaedic treatments including injury repair, joint replacement, sports injuries
max_hospitals.max_surgeries_intro: Some of the surgical procedures performed at Max are:
max_hospitals.max_surgery1: Robotic and minimally invasive surgeries in many specialties (oncology, urology, cardiac)
max_hospitals.max_surgery2: Major open surgeries: organ transplants, complex cancer surgeries
max_hospitals.max_surgery3: Cardio-thoracic surgeries (bypass, congenital heart surgeries, valve replacements)
max_hospitals.max_implant1: Implants: Joint replacements, pacemakers and cardiac devices, dental implants, cochlear implants in some centres.
max_hospitals.max_implant2: Transplants: Kidney, Liver, Bone Marrow (in certain Max centres), possibly Heart (depends on centre), etc.
